## Research

My work develops statistical methodology for high-dimensional and structured data, with particular interests in:

- multi-view and multi-omics data integration;
- high-dimensional mediation analysis;
- statistical methods for microbiome and compositional data;
- high-dimensional inference; and
- multiple testing and false-discovery-rate control.

[Explore research](research.qmd){.button .button-primary}
[View publications](publications.qmd){.button .button-secondary}
